audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Qiyana 'he/his/him' throughout, and the content layer described a 'dash-reset combo' she does not have.
audit.why: Qiyana is female (champ-gender.js). Her two dashes are Terrashape (W, 7s, 1100 range, also enchants her weapon off terrain) and Audacity (E, 11/10/9/8/7s, 650 range). Neither resets.
audit.corrected: Difficulty framed on the real pair: a 1100-unit wall dash into a 650-unit gap-closer, on 7s and 11s, against a champion whose only escape is a 22-second flight.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike claimed your ultimate 'Voice of Light' gives long-range poke that outranges her engage, and said you win level 6 — while the chart gives level 6 to Qiyana.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's ultimate is Falling Star / The Skies Descend: a 1250-range impact that stuns, on 120/110/100s. It is not poke and it is not a zone you can hold up. The page also referred to his 'orbs', which belong to a kit that no longer exists.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as one 120-second stun against two dashes — a real answer, but only one per fight, which is why the row stays hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere did the page say that her damage cancels your channels, which is the actual reason the trade never completes.
audit.why: Breath of Light and Astral Flight are both flagged interruptible channels. Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal (Q, 7s, 525 range) carries hard CC depending on her element, and Supreme Display of Talent (R, 120s, 950 range) knocks up and stuns.
audit.corrected: State it: the beam only completes when her Q and R are spent, and Audacity is what puts her inside that 525 range in the first place. Terrashape needs terrain to enchant, so which wall she is standing next to tells you what her Q will do.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Catalogue defect 3. Real numbers: Audacity 11s at rank 1, Terrashape 7s, Elemental Wrath 7s, Supreme Display of Talent 120s, Astral Flight 22s.
46.54% over 318 games matches a hard early lane that only flips on items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems in the chart: phases[5].side read 'Qiyana' and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] both read 'Aurelion Sol'; and whys[4] described YOU winning level 6 under a row that gives level 6 to Qiyana.
audit.why: A row that argues with itself, and a why that argues with its own verdict.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol with ratings and whys rewritten; whys[4] rewritten to explain why level 6 is still hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and the content layer twice claimed a magnitude ('two-shots you', 'your squishy 550HP frame') with no source.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed plus catalogue defect 6 — the kit gives no such numbers.
audit.corrected: Bullets rewritten to match their titles; the invented magnitudes replaced with the real ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

audit.whatIsWrong: Surviving PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol language: the content layer still described "Comet" / "Comet stacking", which is Comet of Legend from the old kit. The live kit has no Comet — the permanent stacking resource is Stardust (Cosmic Creator).
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/aurelionsol.json lists P Cosmic Creator, Q Breath of Light, W Astral Flight, E Singularity, R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. No ability named Comet exists. The Arcane Comet references in report[6] are the rune and are correct — only these content-layer scaling lines were wrong.
audit.corrected: "Comet"/"Comet stacking" replaced with stardust, which is the resource those sentences were actually describing.

edits.before: You're outclassed levels 1-5 — Qiyana's dash-reset combo through terrain closes distance faster than you can kite, and she two-shots you with Terrashape empowered abilities if she catches you near any wall. Ward the river bush the moment it spawns since her jungler synergy off the level-2 skip is the single biggest early threat.

edits.before: Level 6 is your turning point — Voice of Light gives you the range to poke her down before she's in E-dash distance and lets you actually punish her engage attempts instead of just surviving them. Keep shoving to force the fight at range rather than letting her pick the angle, and track her jungler, since her all-in works off vision-denied flanks and a wall she can enchant.

notes: Qiyana is female — the full layer used he/his/him; corrected. Content-layer errors fixed: 'Voice of Light' (three places) is not Aurelion Sol's ultimate, and 'orbs' / 'orb uptime' / 'orb damage' belong to the pre-rework kit entirely — replaced with Breath of Light, the black hole and Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Two unsourced magnitudes removed ('two-shots you', 'your squishy 550HP frame'). She has no dash reset: her mobility is Terrashape (7s, 1100) and Audacity (11s at rank 1, 650). whys[4] claimed you win level 6 while win[4] and phases[4].side both give it to Qiyana — the why was rewritten to agree with its own row rather than flipping the row. Cross-layer chart disagreement fixed on rows 6 and 7. Not asserted: which element gives her Q its hard CC — Riot's text only says 'a bonus effect based on her element', so only the general 'her element Q cancels the channel' claim is made.
